Office Language Doctor 0.6.0 Community Edition consolidates the major improvements developed after the initial 0.5.0 public baseline.

## Highlights

- Full detection and repair coverage for all 24 official EU languages, with 29 detected language families in total.
- Complete Catalan, Spanish and English interface localization.
- Paragraph-aware Word auditing for documents split into multiple proofing runs.
- Explicit paragraph review actions while keeping Smart Fix conservative.
- Reliable missing proofing-language tags can now be reviewed and repaired across supported formats.
- Improved Catalan / Valencian review with explicit variant selection.
- Repaired documents are immediately rescanned so counters, filters, Smart Fix state and exports reflect the repaired copy.
- Manual Smart Fix review decisions survive repeated repair passes where they remain applicable.
- Localized user-facing document errors instead of leaking technical parser messages.
- Cooperative processing keeps large-document scans responsive.
- Bounded audit pagination for large documents while full CSV/JSON export remains available.
- More reliable document-session handling, including failed replacement scans and repeated selection of the same file.
- Stronger operation locking prevents audit state from changing while a scan or repair is already running.
- CI coalesces obsolete branch runs so the approved self-hosted runner validates the latest branch state.

## Validation

- 17 repairable Word, PowerPoint, OpenDocument and RTF formats.
- Full-document DOCX/PPTX regression covering audit, review, repair, rescan and report generation.
- Cross-format missing proofing-tag regression for DOCX, PPTX, ODT, ODP, ODS and RTF.
- 12,000-fragment audit-session regression.
- Real DOCM and PPTM VBA execution validated before and after repair.
- Automated DOCM/PPTM regression preserves `vbaProject.bin` byte-for-byte.
- OTT, OTP and OTS validated through a real LibreOffice 25.2.3.2 engine round-trip.
- ODT, ODP and ODS have representative LibreOffice validation.
- RTF has representative Microsoft Word validation.
- Final Windows self-hosted CI and GitHub Pages deployment passed for the 0.6.0 release commit.

## Scope

Office Language Doctor remains privacy-first and browser-only. Documents are processed locally and are not uploaded to a backend.

XLSX remains outside proofing-language metadata repair scope, and legacy `.doc`, `.ppt` and `.xls` formats remain unsupported.
